task: Prevent failed delivery updates from permanently locking Special requests
scenarios: A Sales Order with one native order-level Custom Discount% query row absent from the REST item sublist supports delivery-header preparation and update, preserving every commercial field.
Missing, duplicate or foreign material rows still reject before any NetSuite write. Existing financial adjustment readers remain strict.
Delivery preparation failure without a persisted remote plan is recorded as failed and releases request editing; error, target and audit history remain available.
Sales can discard an unapplied failed or abandoned delivery attempt without any NetSuite call, with store, revision, journal ownership and active-operation protection.

An incomplete delivery header remains editable. Saving edited details replaces the old attempt, retains its audit evidence, and uses a new current NetSuite baseline. Explicit Retry retains the original saved target and plan.
A potentially applied saved plan cannot be silently discarded; retry or explicit replacement remains available. Concurrent operations retain their advisory and row locks.
Unrelated readiness and historical line-reconciliation warnings do not prevent a delivery-header save. Fulfillment, planning, order-creation and quantity-review guards remain enforced.
A readiness reminder does not prevent requesting closure. Linked-order fulfillment/billing protections remain unless the user explicitly chooses a separate request-only closure behavior.

failureModel.commercialDataLoss: Network-boundary tests assert header-only PATCH and unchanged materials, rates, discounts and order links
failureModel.permanentLock: Preparation failure, retry, replacement and cancellation database/API/browser regressions
failureModel.unsafeCancellation: Saved-plan rejection, scope/revision checks and active-operation lock tests
failureModel.concurrentOrStaleSave: Existing advisory lock plus row revision checks, explicit stale-journal tests
failureModel.discountMismatch: Malformed/duplicate/foreign row examples and generated discount-row cases

setup.git: Preserve unrelated workspace changes; no commits or reset
setup.tools: Existing Node, fast-check, c8, TypeScript, ESLint and Playwright
setup.tests: Use standard isolated Compose, mbbs-tests.slice and bounded containers; register teardown first and remove all disposable containers, volumes and networks
setup.release: Capture current production image; apply only scoped changes; verify candidate runtime and retain image rollback
setup.productionData: Read-only diagnosis; use normal recovery APIs only for explicitly authorized recovery. Do not change NetSuite order lines.

amendments.reason: An uncertain remote delivery may already be applied, including when replacing it with pickup.
scenarios: Retain the previous plan as recovery evidence until a replacement is prepared; failed re-preparation stays recoverable and cannot be discarded.
A replacement pickup re-reads and verifies NetSuite even when the original application method is already pickup.
amendments.existingAssertionChange: The legacy pickup preflight failure now expects nonblocking failed status, as explicitly required by scenario 3. All retry/target/idempotence assertions retained.

amendments.userClarification: Close SPREQ-000021 and both linked NetSuite orders; do not archive only the application request.
amendments.closureInvestigation: Readiness is not the stored blocker. Verify safe closure of already fulfilled/billed lines against NetSuite documentation; never change fulfillment, billing, pricing or quantity records.

amendments.userAuthorization: Close the request and both SO and PO in NetSuite, preserving posted history.
scenarios: Normal confirmed closure explicitly closes the remaining lines, even when prior fulfillment/receipt or billing exists. Legacy plans retain their stricter semantics.
Snapshot fulfillment and billing quantities before writing; any concurrent change stops closure before the first write. Only isClosed flags change.
Readiness reminders neither block Sales requesting closure nor SCM confirmation; reminders disappear after verified closure.
amendments.existingAssertionChange: Service preparation input now explicitly includes closeRemaining:true; existing identity and commercial preservation assertions retained.
